scripts.dev: bun run setup:dev && cd tauri && bun run tauri dev
scripts.build: ./scripts/build-server.sh && cd tauri && bun run tauri build
scripts.generate:keys: cd tauri && bun tauri signer generate -w ~/.tauri/voicebox-ds.key
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p app/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bunx tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bunx tsc -p tauri/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.ci: bun run typecheck && bun run build:web
scripts.test:upstream: bun test app/tests/query-client-offline.test.ts app/tests/serverStore.test.ts && bun test app/tests/server-startup-url.test.tsx && bun test app/tests/capture-upload-errors.test.tsx
